productTitle: MUKOKO 24oz Glass Water Bottle, Motivational Water Tumbler with 2 Lids and Straw, Time Marker Silicone Sleeve, Olive
title: Still has plastic
text: I bought this because I thought it would be a glass bottle with a wooden top and a glass straw. While the bottle is glass, even the wooden-looking top is plastic and the straw is plastic. I was spending this much money to get something plastic free. Left with disappointment.
